column3: NASB supplies “us” after “torn,” and renders “bind up” as “bandage.”
“From two days” is rendered “after two days.”
“Pursue” is rendered “press on,” and “steadfast” “as certain as.”
“To you” is rendered “with you,” and “rising early going” “which goes away early”; NASB adds “For.”
The Hebrew perfects are rendered as past (“I have hewn”), and “your judgments are light that goes forth” is rendered “the judgments on you are like the light that goes forth.”
“Covenant loyalty” is rendered “loyalty,” and “not sacrifice” “rather than sacrifice.”
“Doers of wickedness” is rendered “wrongdoers,” and “tracked from blood” “Tracked with bloody footprints.”
“He has appointed a harvest” is rendered “there is a harvest appointed”; “turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
